nav.allFeaturesDesc: Screen preview, zoom measurement, and more.
nav.quickActionsDesc: Click directly on the canvas and apply instantly

hero.title: See screen details
hero.description: PinLens is a real-time screen preview tool built for macOS.
hero.descriptionExtended: Select any region, zoom into details, and inspect alignment with rulers, guides, and grids.

features.title: Preview, zoom, and measure in one place
features.description: PinLens brings region capture, zoom inspection, design aids, and quick click into one lightweight window for UI design, debugging, and content creation.

areaSelection.name: Area Selection & Real-time Preview
areaSelection.description: Flexibly drag to select any screen area, supports 8-direction resizing and moving, real-time display of selected area content.
areaSelection.cardDescription: Flexibly drag to select any screen area
areaSelection.label: Screen Capture

zoom.name: Zoom & Navigation
zoom.description: Supports 0.5x - 10x zoom, mouse gesture zoom, real-time display of zoom level and viewport position.

designTools.name: Design Auxiliary Tools
designTools.description: Toggleable horizontal/vertical rulers, custom guides, guide position adjustment and deletion.

quickActions.name: Quick Click
quickActions.description: Enable it to click directly on the canvas, with each click taking effect immediately and fewer confirmation steps.
quickActions.cardDescription: Click the canvas and apply instantly

process.title: Start inspecting in three steps
process.description: No complex setup. Select a region and start previewing, zooming, measuring, and clicking.

step1.title: Launch App
step1.description: Open PinLens from the menu bar and enter region selection mode.

step2.title: Select Area
step2.description: Drag over the screen area you want to inspect, then refine the selection with handles.

step3.title: Inspect Details
step3.description: Zoom, measure, align, and click directly in the dedicated preview window.

system.title: Designed for macOS
system.description: PinLens supports macOS 15.0 and later. Grant screen recording permission on first use to enable real-time preview.

permission.title: Screen Recording Permission
permission.description: Used to capture and preview the selected region

cta.title: Make every detail check faster
cta.description: Download PinLens and handle previewing, zooming, measuring, and quick clicking in one lightweight window.
